selection_process: The Board reserves the right to shortlist applicants for interview
keeping in view the extant guidelines issued from time to time. Applicants must be in regular employment on the date of interview as well as the date of application.
The notice does not describe the interview format or marking.
how_to_apply: Fill up the application form online only, against this Job Description, on the PESB website https://pesb.gov.in/.
The nodal officer/competent authority then forwards the application online through the channel in para V(1). The registration link for nodal officers/competent authorities is on the PESB website.

Submit through the proper channel: Group 'A' Central Government officers (including Armed Forces and AIS) through the Cadre Controlling Authority; officers from Public Sector Banks/Financial Institutions/Autonomous Bodies through their Administrative Ministry/Department.
CMDs/MDs/Functional Directors in CPSE apply through the concerned Administrative Ministry/Department; below Board level in CPSE through the concerned CPSE.

CMDs/MDs/Functional Directors in State PSE apply through the concerned Administrative Secretary and Cadre Controlling Authority, if any, of the State Government; below Board level in SPSE through the concerned SPSE.
Applicants from JVs/Federations apply through their Nodal Officer/Competent Authority; applicants from private companies apply directly to PESB.
Give the undertaking, as part of the application, that you will join the post if selected.
Submit the application online by 03:00 PM on 11.12.2026.
Applicants from Private Companies/JVs/Federations must submit the following along with the application form:
Annual Reports of the three financial years preceding the calendar year in which the post is advertised, of the organisation in which currently working (URL or copies).
Documentary proof that the company is listed, for private company applicants (URL or copies).
Evidence of working at Board level or at least a post of the level immediately below the Board level.
Self-attested copies of documents in support of age and qualifications.
Relevant jobs handled in the past, with details.
important_instructions: Applications are accepted online only. Applications forwarded to PESB in physical form or through e-mail are rejected. No application is entertained under any circumstances after the stipulated date. Incomplete applications and applications not received online within the stipulated date are rejected. An application without the undertaking to join the post, if selected, is rejected. The cadre controlling authority/competent authority should forward only applications of applicants who are clear from the vigilance angle, per DPE guidelines (latest OM No. 15(2)/2001-DPE(GM)-FTS-4199 dated 28.10.2025). The vigilance profile in the 13-point CVC proforma (circular number 10/09/24 dated 06.09.2024) should invariably be attached to the application form. For SPSEs/JVs/Federations, the forwarding authority should forward only vigilance-clear applications; the CVC 13-point vigilance profile may be attached. Central Government/Armed Forces/AIS and bank/financial institution/autonomous body candidates: unwillingness to join after the interview or after the offer of appointment leads to debarment for two years from the date of interview or offer, from Board level posts in any CPSE. CPSE candidates: the same two-year debarment applies, but for Board level posts in any CPSE other than the one to which the candidate belongs. SPSE/Private Sector/JV/Federation candidates: two-year debarment from Board level posts in any CPSE. No request for relaxation or otherwise is entertained. Communications go to: Secretary, Public Enterprises Selection Board, Public Enterprises Bhawan, BlockNo. 14, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003.

content_sections.heading: About SCI
content_sections.text: The Shipping Corporation of India Limited is a Government Company incorporated on 2 October 1961, with its registered office at Mumbai, Maharashtra. The notice describes it as a Schedule 'A' Navratna CPSE listed on NSE and BSE, with three segments: Bulk Carrier & Tankers, Liner Services, and Technical and Managed vessels services. It employed 445 regular shore employees (Executive 424, Non-Executive 21) as on 30.06.2026, along with about 1855 seafarers.

content_sections.heading: SCI Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The notice states that the total timeline for receipt of complete applications in PESB is 30 days from the date of uploading the Job Description on the PESB website.

content_sections.heading: SCI Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Adequate experience/exposure at senior level of management in a large organization of repute, of which at least five years during the last ten years should have been in shipping and shipping operations. Experience in tramp trading connected with shipping organization/ sales, purchase and/or commercial operations is desirable. The applicant must, on the date of application and on the date of interview, be employed in a regular capacity, not in a contractual/ad-hoc capacity, in one of the following: A Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE), including a full-time functional Director in the Board of a CPSE. Central Government Group 'A' Officers, including the Armed Forces of the Union and All India Services, and officers from Public Sector Banks / Financial Institutions / Autonomous Bodies, etc. A State Public Sector Enterprise (SPSE) with annual turnover of Rs. 5,000 crore or more. A Private Sector Company, Joint Venture (50:50 JVs of Central/State Governments and JVs of CPSEs with other CPSEs/organisations) or National/State level Cooperative Federation with annual turnover of Rs. 5,000 crore or more. For private companies, preference would be given to candidates from listed companies, and applicants from private companies, JVs and Federations will be arranged in order of annual turnover. Turnover is the average audited annual turnover of the three financial years preceding the calendar year in which the post is advertised. CPSEs: minimum length of service in the eligible scale is one year for internal candidates and two years for others, as on the date of vacancy. Central Government Group 'A' officers including AIS and Autonomous Bodies: must hold a post of the level of Joint Secretary in Govt. of India or an equivalent post with equivalent scale of pay, on substantive basis, on the date of application. Officers drawing the eligible pay scale merely on Non-Functional upgradation (NFU) / Next Below Rule (NBR) basis without a substantive post are not eligible. Public Sector Bank / Financial Institution applicants: must hold a Board level post, or at least the level immediately below the Board level for one year, on the date of application. Armed Forces of the Union: must hold the level of Major General in the Army or equivalent rank in Navy/Air Force on the date of application. SPSE / Private Companies / JVs / Federations: must be working at Board level or at least the level immediately below the Board level on the date of application. Eligible scales of pay printed in the notice for CPSE applicants: Central Government Officers, including the Armed Forces of the Union and All India Services, and officers from Public Sector Banks / Financial Institutions / Autonomous Bodies etc., are eligible for consideration only on immediate absorption basis. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the SCI Director (Bulk Carriers & Tankers) post?
faq.answer: Applicants must submit the online application by 03:00 PM on 11.12.2026. Late applications are not entertained under any circumstances.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the nodal officer or competent authority to forward applications?
faq.answer: Forwarding authorities, for all applicants except those of private companies, must forward applications online to PESB by 05:00 PM on 21.12.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for SCI Director (Bulk Carriers & Tankers)?
faq.answer: The applicant should be an Engineering Graduate or a Master (Foreign Going) from a recognized university/institution. MBA/PGDM is an added advantage.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The minimum is 45 years. The maximum is 2 years of residual service for Internal applicants and 3 years for Others, as on the date of vacancy with respect to superannuation at 60 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for the post?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 180000 – 340000 (IDA), Schedule A.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill up the application form online on the PESB website https://pesb.gov.in/, and the nodal officer/competent authority forwards it online. Private company applicants apply directly to PESB.

faq.question: Q7. How are applicants selected?
faq.answer: The Board reserves the right to shortlist applicants for interview, keeping in view the extant guidelines issued from time to time.

faq.question: Q8. Who can apply for this post?
faq.answer: Only applicants in regular employment (not contractual/ad-hoc) on the date of application and the date of interview, in a CPSE, Central Government Group 'A' service, bank/financial institution/autonomous body, qualifying SPSE, or qualifying private company, JV or Federation.

faq.question: Q9. For how long is the appointment?
faq.answer: The appointment is for five years from the date of joining or up to the date of superannuation or until further orders, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. What happens if a selected candidate refuses to join?
faq.answer: A candidate who conveys unwillingness to join after the interview or after the offer of appointment is debarred for two years from Board level posts in CPSEs, with no relaxation. CPSE candidates are debarred only from CPSEs other than their own.
